_comment: Per-level feature selection, calibrated against profile/map.json (R's census) so
build counts land inside harness.json's count_ratio envelope. Level 0 is exempt from the
road-link ratio only. Contract: parser/kiwiw/selection.py. Tests: parser/tests/test_selection.py.
Calibration: tags-only osmium tallies of the Australia extract compared with R's per-level
counts. Road links split per parcel, so national way counts under-approximate link counts.
Selection is a stopgap for count parity; the source-derived selection replaces it (plan 03).

rules._calibration_note: L0: R links 9.9M (exempt, capacity-bound). Background admits every non-road way (catch-all 288, ratio 0.97x). Names: all OSM-nameable classes total ~0.11x of R's 19.1M; the shortfall is a natural deviation, since R carries address strings OSM Australia lacks.

L2: R links 95,877. motorway+trunk+primary = 167,420 ways (1.75x raw; parcel splitting may push it toward the 2.0x ceiling). R names are place-type 308 only, so road and background names are off; place set chosen for 0.75x of R's 40,169.
L4: R links 41,786. motorway+trunk = 81,561 ways (1.95x, near ceiling). Names: city+town+village+island+islet = 0.83x of R's 4,042.
L6: R links 20,738. motorway = 14,004 ways (0.68x). Names: city+town = 1.20x of R's 1,022.
L8: R links 7,663. motorway = 14,004 ways (1.83x, near ceiling); no finer class exists. Names: city+island = 1.37x of R's 209.

L10/12: R has no links, 25 backgrounds (289:6, 306:11, 528:8) and 8 names (state 6, country 1, continent 1). natural=bay is the only mapped 289 tag near the target (1.04x). 306 is unreachable (state boundaries are relations) and 528 is unimplemented; see docs/design/osm-vocabulary-mapping.md.
L12: as L10; one global parcel, so zero roads is required for the capacity ceiling.
